name: 读表报营收
tagline: 走查用：从我的表里报出营业收入

workflow.title: 读表作答
workflow.summary: 从你的表里找到问的那一年的营业收入
workflow.method_text: List the user's data with list_my_data and read it with read_my_data. Find the row the question asks about and the column of the year it asks about, and report the number exactly as written. If the table does not have it, say so in answer and leave figures empty. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences: {"answer": string, "figures": [{"item": string, "period": string, "value": string, "citation": {"dataset_id": string, "version": string, "sha256": string, "page": number}}], "conclusion": ""}. Leave conclusion empty. No buy or sell advice.
